name: @loom/media-gallery
description: Multi-modal media, claim-checked by ADDRESS (loom R5 + loom-ui U9/U9b): an agent loop whose tool returns a tiny generated PNG as a ContentRef, a scripted vision model that sees the resolved bytes, a ContentResolver that authorizes per tenant, a provider capability allowlist with a text-only fallback, an x-content-ref tool argument that only accepts a ref the caller may read, a loom-ui gallery of Image widgets, and content GC that pins refs a log still cites. Headless and offline.
